extraFacts.fact: A 3:1 safety (design) factor means the minimum burst pressure of the hose is three times its maximum working pressure; the working pressure is the maximum for continuous duty and burst pressure is a test figure, not a working limit.
extraFacts.source: Indus guide: industrial hose safety factors (/blog/industrial-hose-safety-factors); hose maker catalogues

extraFacts.fact: NPSM is the straight (parallel) American pipe thread for mechanical joints and FNPSM is its female form; NPT is the tapered pipe thread.
In cam and groove couplings, type C is a coupler with a hose shank and type E is an adapter with a hose shank; the coupler and adapter lock together with two cam arms.
extraFacts.source: MIL-C-27487 / A-A-59326 cam and groove coupling types

extraFacts.fact: A suction hose has an internal helix so it resists collapse under vacuum, while a discharge hose is built for positive pressure and may collapse under vacuum; a suction-and-discharge hose does both.
extraFacts.source: Indus guides: water suction and dewatering hose; PVC or rubber suction hose
